scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @demiurgejs/core build && pnpm generate:routes && pnpm --filter @demiurge-examples/basic-blog dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @demiurgejs/core build && pnpm generate:routes && pnpm typecheck:consumers && pnpm build:examples
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @demiurgejs/core test && pnpm test:scaffold && pnpm test:tooling
scripts.test:tooling: node --import tsx --test tooling/*.test.ts && tsx tests/tooling/release-check.ts && tsx tests/tooling/pr-title.ts && tsx tests/tooling/type-evidence-lint-rules.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm generate:routes && pnpm --filter @demiurgejs/core typecheck && pnpm typecheck:consumers
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm --filter @demiurgejs/core build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm coverage && pnpm test:scaffold && pnpm test:tooling && pnpm build:examples && pnpm test:examples && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:pack
